fields.title: Customer insight / aspect record
fields.description: Three record shapes, discriminated by `recordType`. PRODUCT_INSIGHT is one ASIN with its AI review summary and the full aspect list. ASPECT is one aspect of one product, with sentiment, mention count split into positive/negative, Amazon's one-sentence verdict on that aspect, and rank — the shape to sort and filter on. CAPTCHA_ESCALATION marks an ASIN that was bot-walled or an input that was not a valid ASIN, so a short run is never mistaken for a product with no opinions. Products with too few reviews carry no insight widget at all, which is why `hasInsights` exists and every field is nullable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The ASIN (or raw input value) this row came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-dp-insights for scraped data, S0-diagnostic for a failure row.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the fetch.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain suffix the row was scraped from.

reviewCount.title: Review count
reviewCount.description: Number of customer ratings the insights are drawn from.

aiSummary.title: AI review summary
aiSummary.description: Amazon's generated 'Customers say' paragraph. Written by Amazon from customer reviews, not by this actor.

hasInsights.title: Has insights
hasInsights.description: False when Amazon served no insight widget — normal for products with few reviews. Distinguishes 'no opinions published' from a failed parse.

aspectCount.title: Aspect count
aspectCount.description: Number of aspects Amazon published for this product.

gapAspectCount.title: Content gap count
gapAspectCount.description: Negative plus mixed aspects — the copy opportunities.

totalMentions.title: Total mentions
totalMentions.description: Sum of mention counts across all aspects with a published count.

contentGaps.title: Content gaps
contentGaps.description: Names of the negative and mixed aspects — what a competitor's listing has not convincingly addressed.

topAspects.title: Top aspects
topAspects.description: Five most-mentioned aspects, regardless of sentiment.

aspects.title: All aspects
aspects.description: Full aspect list as objects with aspect, sentiment, mentions, positive, negative and aspectSummary.

aspect.title: Aspect
aspect.description: On an ASPECT row: the thing customers talked about, e.g. mixability, value for money.

sentiment.title: Sentiment
sentiment.description: POSITIVE, MIXED or NEGATIVE, as classified by Amazon.

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.description: How many reviews mention this aspect. Null when Amazon published the aspect without a count (localized pages).

positive.title: Positive mentions
positive.description: Reviews mentioning this aspect favourably. Null when Amazon published the aspect without a split.

negative.title: Negative mentions
negative.description: Reviews mentioning this aspect unfavourably. positive + negative equals mentions — Amazon publishes no neutral bucket.

aspectSummary.title: Aspect summary
aspectSummary.description: Amazon's generated one-sentence verdict on this single aspect, e.g. "Customers praise the writing quality of the book, describing it as one of the most beautiful ways to tell a story." Written by Amazon, not by this actor. Distinct from aiSummary, which covers the whole product.

mentionRank.title: Mention rank
mentionRank.description: Rank of this aspect within the product, 1 = most mentioned.

mentionSharePercent.title: Mention share percent
mentionSharePercent.description: This aspect's share of the product's total counted mentions.

isContentGap.title: Is content gap
isContentGap.description: True for negative and mixed aspects — the rows worth acting on.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: BLOCKED or INVALID_ASIN on a diagnostic row, otherwise null.
